privatePostView.description: View of one private-tier post (tools.kryphocron.feed.postPrivate) that the requester is authorized to read. Its counts count only what the requester is entitled to know exists, matched by post URI (never CID), so they survive an audience edit that changes the CID: a reply or private quote the requester could not read, or one by an account with a block either way with the requester, is not counted. Likes and reposts are counted from community members only, in every mode. No bookmarkCount is emitted.

record.description: The decoded private record, with $type 'tools.kryphocron.feed.postPrivate'. Carries text, createdAt, audienceList (at-uri) and, for replies, reply ({root, parent} strong refs), and facets, embed, langs and labels as the record stored them (embed and facet features in either the tools.kryphocron.feed.postPublic or the app.bsky form). audienceList may be absent when the record was written without one; that represents a self-only post, returned only to its owner. Encoded-content fields are never emitted.

embed.description: The stock view of the record's embed, built from either $type form. A quoted private post is read for the requester as any private post is: readable gives #viewRecord with the decoded record as its value, or #viewDetached when the quoted post's postgate detaches this post; unreadable, blocked or nonexistent all give the same #viewNotFound. #viewUnavailable (app.nearhorizon.private.defs#viewUnavailable) is given instead while this AppView is degraded, for every private quote it does not show, and otherwise for the requester's own quoted private post that cannot be read yet; retry after its retryAfter seconds. A quoted public post is shown only when this AppView stores it; otherwise, for record and recordWithMedia embeds alike, embed is absent and the client renders the quote from record.embed. Quotes are not followed beyond one level. A private post's video plays from its author's PDS: playlist is the MP4 blob, and there is no thumbnail. A quoted public post's video plays as the operator configures, from the video CDN (playlist and thumbnail) or from its author's PDS.

labels.description: Labels on the post: its author's self-labels (src the author's DID, cts the post's createdAt), then the labels this AppView's operator applied.

replyCount.description: Private replies to this post that the requester's audience rules admit, not taken down or hidden by moderation, by accounts with no block either way with the requester. A reply that is temporarily unreadable for every reader alike (its author's indexing in progress, content that does not decode) is counted. Replies the root's threadgate hides are counted, as on public posts.

repostCount.description: Reposts by community members with no block either way with the requester.

likeCount.description: Likes by community members with no block either way with the requester.

quoteCount.description: Private posts quoting this post that the requester's audience rules admit (as replyCount), plus community members' public posts quoting it whose author has no block either way with the requester.

audience.description: The governing audience: the current audience of the post's thread root, or of its branch root for a reply in a private branch under a public post (the post itself when top-level), while this AppView holds its record. On the author's own read it appears only when the author is that audience's owner or may read under it. Absent otherwise, and when the record is gone; the author still sees record.audienceList, the audience the post names.

droppedFields.description: Only on the author's own view: the parts of the post's encoded content that this view leaves out because the read refused them (the wrong type, or over 64 KiB). Absent when nothing was left out, and always absent for any other reader. A client re-encoding the post from this view would lose these parts.

notServed.description: Only on the author's own view, while getMembership lists 'private.notServed': present when this AppView would not serve the post to any reader of its audience, with each post-level reason once, in this order. placement: the post is not attached to a thread its audience can read (no valid thread root or branch root, an audience not owned by the thread's owner, the governing audience's record missing, the root or a post above it hidden or unreadable to everyone). standing: the author does not stand under the thread's governing audience, or the thread owner's account is not active. chainCap: the chain of replies above the post is longer than this AppView walks. overClaim: the record's clear mentionDids, quote or mediaKinds claim something its content does not carry. Absent when the post is served to its audience, and always absent for any other reader and on a quoted post. Whether any reader is inside the audience, and anything that depends on who the reader is, is not considered.

viewer.description: The requester's state on the post. Carries bookmarked (the requester's private bookmark, app.nearhorizon.private.createBookmark), always present. like and repost are the URIs of the requester's own newest like and repost of the post, matched by URI, present when they exist. threadMuted is true when the requester muted (app.bsky.graph.muteThread) the thread root the post's record claims (reply.root, or the post itself when top-level), and absent otherwise. replyDisabled comes from the threadgate of the thread root the post's record claims (reply.root, or the post itself when top-level), and only when that root was read for the requester in the same request: the post itself, a parent in the thread, another post of the page, or the root a thread request reads. So a feed reply usually carries none, and a thread does; a followingRule or listRule this AppView cannot answer from its own rows also leaves it out (fail open). embeddingDisabled is true when the post's own postgate disables embedding and the requester is not its author. pinned and knownLikers are not emitted.

reason.description: On a feed item of getTimeline or getAuthorFeed only: present when the item is a community member's repost of this post, which then sorts by the repost's time. by is the reposter, uri the repost record; cid is not emitted. The same post can appear as itself and as a repost.

threadgate.description: On a top-level post: its threadgate (an app.bsky.feed.threadgate record with the post's record key, in the post author's repository). lists holds only the lists this AppView serves from its own rows. A gate only flags and hides replies; it never admits a reader the audience does not.

reply.description: On a feed item of getTimeline or getAuthorFeed only, while getMembership lists 'private.replyContext': present when the item's post is a reply (its record.reply), with the root and the parent it names. Absent on any other view.

replyRef.description: A feed item's reply context, in the shape of app.bsky.feed.defs#replyRef. A private root or parent is read for the requester as getPosts reads it, in the same request, and carries the same decoration (labels, counts, viewer, gates, the record part of embed); one the requester cannot read, or that does not exist, is the same #notFoundPost. A public root or parent is given by reference (#publicPostRef), to hydrate through a public AppView.

publicPostRef.description: A public post (app.bsky.feed.post) by a community member, given by reference: hydrate it through a public AppView. This AppView does not serve public post bodies from a private method.

bookmarkView.description: One of the requester's private bookmarks, with the post as the requester may read it now.

createdAt.description: When the bookmark was first made; a repeat keeps it.

subject.description: The bookmarked post, with the cid given when it was last bookmarked.

audienceView.description: A post's audience (tools.kryphocron.policy.audience). Its member list is never included. A rename shows once the audience record is next indexed.

mode.description: The audience's mode as stored. Absent when the record has none, which reads as 'list'.

name.description: The audience's label, as its owner wrote it.

privateThreadView.description: A node in a private thread. Parents and replies the requester cannot see are omitted without distinction.

parent.description: The parent post: a private post, or a public post when a private reply's parent is public. Absent at the thread root and where the parent chain stops at a missed parent.

replies.description: Authorized private replies to this post, ordered by createdAt ascending, at most 50 per node. When the thread's root (the anchor's claimed reply.root) was read for the requester, replies its threadgate lists in hiddenReplies are left out, except for their own author.

publicParent.description: A public post that is the parent of a private reply.

notificationPreferences.description: The requester's preferences for its private notifications, one per reason. reply and quote cover private posts replying to or quoting the requester's private post and community members' public posts doing the same; like and repost are community members' likes and reposts of the requester's private posts; mention is a mention of the requester in a private post. list: false leaves the reason out of listNotifications and getUnreadCount; include: 'follows' keeps it only from accounts the requester follows, as this AppView has indexed the follows when the notifications are read; push is stored and has no effect (this AppView sends no push for private notifications). subscribedPost: new private posts and replies by accounts the requester subscribes to (putActivitySubscription); it has list and push only. Always returned, though not required, so an older reader needs nothing new.

unavailablePost.description: One of the requester's own private posts this response read and could not serve yet: the cause clears without any record changing.

reason.description: syncing: this AppView has not yet seen every change the post's read depends on; indexing: the post's author or audience owner is still being indexed.

viewUnavailable.description: A quoted private post this AppView cannot show yet, in place of app.bsky.embed.record#viewNotFound: while degraded, for every private quote it does not show (whether or not the post exists or is readable); otherwise only for the requester's own post that cannot be read yet. Not a statement that the post is gone.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before asking again.
